style.english: Use plain technical English. Define a term before relying on it and prefer short cause-and-effect sentences.
style.burmese: Write like a patient Burmese technical instructor. Explain the meaning naturally; do not translate English sentence structure word for word. Keep sentences short.

rules: Never translate commands, flags, code, paths, filenames, acronyms, or product names.
When an English technical term is retained, explain what it does in natural Burmese at first use.
Prefer common Burmese verbs and direct actions over formal noun-heavy constructions.
Use the same preferred term consistently within and across cards.
